Anya (PM): Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — prototype for Prompt Sets & Evals v2. Looking for quick feedback on scorecard layout + approval workflow before next sprint. Happy to sync Fri 11am if needed.
Mike J (Eng): Quick thought — regression diff timeline gets noisy with many runs. Can we collapse identical runs or group by baseline?
Sanjay (Design): Agreed. Also the scorecard chips feel visually heavy; suggest compact numeric pills and clearer hierarchy for metric names. Contrast on the green pass badge is low.
Lexi (Ops): Accessibility nit: approval modal needs aria-labelledby, focus trap, and visible keyboard focus states. Primary action must be reachable with Enter after modal opens.
DesignBot: Auto a11y check: "Pass" badge contrast ratio 2.4:1 (AA requires 3:1 for UI components). Recommend darker green (#1f8f3e) or bold text.
Anya (PM): Good catches. Mike — grouping diffs by baseline + a "show more" for older runs sound ok? That would reduce clutter.
Mike J (Eng): Yep. Implementation idea: group by baseline hash, show latest 3 per group, collapsed count for older. Also cache rendered diffs client-side to avoid re-rendering huge HTML on expand.
Sanjay (Design): For the scorecard area: move the overall score left, metric rows center, and the pass/fail badge right. Swap full-width cards for a condensed table when there are >6 metrics.
Lexi (Ops): Auditability: when someone approves we need user, timestamp, scorecard snapshot id, and optional approval note. Put a small permalink to the snapshot in the audit entry. Legal wants retention policy — FYI they asked for 7 years.
Anya (PM): Copy suggestion: change CTA text from "Approve" to "Approve changes" and "Reject" to "Request changes" — clearer intent. Also add a subtle confirmation step if overall score < threshold.
Mike J (Eng): If we support per-metric thresholds we should surface which metric triggered the fail state and highlight that row with a 1px red outline + tooltip explaining the metric value vs threshold.
Sanjay (Design): Micro-interaction: hovering a diff thumbnail should show inline mini diff; clicking expands full diff. Keyboard users: arrow keys to move between runs + Enter to expand. Need visible focus ring on thumbnails (not just color change).
Anya (PM): Proposal: default approval threshold = 0.85 overall, with ability to override per-metric. Tooltip: "Thresholds can be tuned per team". Also add an optional auto-approve rule for minor visual-only regressions.
Lexi (Ops): On notifications: when approval happens send a Slack thread to prompt-owners and CC the audit-log channel. Also add webhook support for enterprise customers.
DesignBot: Regression diff size warning added: if diff HTML > 1MB show a "snapshot too large" indicator and create downloadable artifact instead of inline render.
Mike J (Eng): Backend note: snapshot ids should be immutable and referenceable; we'll store diff blobs in object storage with signed URLs. Also add a run-level dedupe pass.
Sanjay (Design): I'll push an updated frame with compact scorecards, focus states, and annotated keyboard flows to #design later today.
Anya (PM): Action items: 1) Sanjay — tweak layout + a11y contrast (due Tue). 2) Mike — grouped diffs + snapshot caching + backend ids. 3) Lexi — define audit log schema + retention reqs. 4) Anya — draft microcopy & approval states for docs.
Lexi (Ops): Added: include version string and commit-like message on prompt-set save so audit entries are human-readable.
Mike J (Eng): Noted. Any objections to the CTA placement being primary-right? That matches other Redwood modals.
Sanjay (Design): Primary-right is fine — just ensure visual weights are consistent for keyboard navigation (order vs visual position).
Anya (PM): If no major objections I'll mark this ready for grooming tomorrow. :thumbsup:
